workflowName: Social Media Effectiveness Tracker - 海外多平台帖子数据更新
description: Refresh post metrics (views, likes, comments) for every row of the social-media tracking table in Bitable, across Instagram, X, YouTube and Facebook, via Apify.

input.description: No runtime input. Configure the 配置参数 node (Bitable app token, table id, Lark app id/secret) after import.

output.description: Rows written to Bitable; see the last node for per-platform results.

executionId.description: Returned by n8n execute_workflow; poll get_execution for the result.

sideEffects: Updates existing Bitable records by record_id
